lines.l: I'm living the moment, I want it, I own it, my future
I'm in it, I'm always up in it
I see it, I need it, I'm taking it
It's mine, it's mine, the light is alive
Oh, I see it, boy, I see it
And I'm in it, it's not where I thought I was gonna be tonight
The sky is falling, and I see it
It won't be long, it won't be long
